findings.headline: Write the boolean value of aria-hidden as "true" or "false".
findings.why: Solid 1 rendered a boolean aria-hidden as the text "true" or "false". Solid 2.0.1 treats every boolean attribute value as presence: true renders aria-hidden="" and false removes it, so assistive technology reads aria-hidden as unset.
findings.guidance: Write a literal as a string (aria-hidden="true"), and wrap an expression in String() (aria-hidden={String(!open())}). The transform makes this edit.

findings.headline: Check whether the value of aria-expanded can be a boolean.
findings.why: Solid 1 rendered a boolean aria-expanded as the text "true" or "false". Solid 2.0.1 treats every boolean attribute value as presence: true renders aria-expanded="" and false removes it, so assistive technology reads aria-expanded as unset.
findings.guidance: If the value can be a boolean, render it as text: aria-expanded={String(value())}, or value() ? "true" : "false". Keep it as is when it is already a string, or undefined to remove the attribute.
